notes.title: UPDATE 2.6
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE 2.6[/b]


[b]EASTER UPDATE[/b]

Yes i know i am a bit late but there is some issues that i cant seem to resolve in the game but i still have some stuff for Easter

Easter level 1
Easter level 2
Easter level 3
Random Easter
Endless Easter


[b]LIST OF ADDITIONS[/b]


When using controller it will now select the next level button automatically
When controller is plugged in it should always chose the first option
Beach balls now bounce you in the Wipeout DLC levels
Bumpers can now be used switch menus in the settings menu
Increased verticality in level generation


[b]LIST OF FIXES[/b]


Fixed cursor interfering with menu when controller is plugged in
Fixed hard lock when disconnecting controller in certain menus
Fixed controller reset button map


[b]LIST OF CHANGES[/b]


Menu has been completely redone
Changed deadzone on controllers to not be as sensitive to stick drift
Changed end level text to be more spread apart

notes.title: FREE TO PLAY!
notes.content:
Lofi Ball has been changed to a free to play model, all of the content that was previously in the game is now free to play, anyone who already purchased the game should get the founders pack automatically

[b] LIST OF CHANGES[/b]

Changed hammer visuals
Changed end glass visuals
Changed menu icons
Changed jump delay time
Changed level menu to display 6 total levels at a time

[b]LIST OF ADDITIONS[/b]

Added target bounce sound in skies levels
Added new material vacantknight
Added new material Lofi
Added new material Jaich
Added Bowling bonus level
Can press the restart button in the end level menu to restart level
Can press the jump button to go to next level when in the end level menu

[b]LIST OF FIXES[/b]

Fix Controller Sensitivity

notes.title: LOFI BALL NEWS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42415630/2a798b43607c1a7f18b06951ea249c9b57c17ff7.png[/img]

So i been thinking about the future of lofi ball and i have some updates and new content in the works but also been thinking about switching the games model from paid to free to play

If the game was to go into a free to play model, what's in the game now would be free and the game would also receive free updates but also would receive paid DLC, also anyone who purchased the game before it going free to play will get a founders pack, that is if the game ends up going free to play

Some stuff that is already in the works is listed below

New Skins
New Materials
New Levels
Fixes
Improvements 

That is all for now 
Have a nice day

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42415630/8c602de7d741e45fec5264ed80c259f8a6af3f62.png[/img]
